title: Band feuds and the toll of the road on marriages
summary: He says he avoided band quarrels, and discusses how touring hurt marriages and families.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Ah, no. No, I don't. I don't know exactly. So many things used to happen in the band, I didn't really, you go crazy worrying about what this guy, and there used to be little arguments in the band and I didn't know anything about it and didn't care and didn't want to know.
Sort of every man for himself to some extent?

Yes. People have trouble with their families or this man might tell another man's wife something. She'd get mad and everybody in the band knew what was happening maybe. And I think I was the only one who didn't want to know what it was so they didn't bother me at all. Because there was always something going on.
Well, fifteen or sixteen people like that, I mean, you expect it.

Yes, there was always fights and sometimes guys old ladies, we'd come home for two hours unexpected and guys would find their old ladies out with somebody else. We'd have a hard time getting them back on the bus. to finish the tour. And then there's other guys could play only certain towns. We we got to certain towns they couldn't go to that town because the sheriff would be waiting for them. All that kind of business.
Well now, don't you think that the life of musicians on the road was pretty darn hard on marriage anyway?
I mean, how can you expect.....

It's imposs- Well I mean, in those days now we would, I've seen us leave New York in January and go all down through Texas and never see New York again until next May. Three or four months you were gone. And that's with just a wife. If you've got children it's harder. It's hard now, but nothing like it used to be. When you go to Europe and you spend two or three weeks, not months, and then you come right back and you go to Canada. And you leave there and you go out to Ohio somewhere.
Well of course, there was another aspect of it too I think that temptations were say put in the way of young men away from home. I mean, that's kind of irresistible too?
